items.text: Across the 11 tumour boards of the network during 2027, does the template package (structured template, coordinator and monthly feedback) increase the proportion of case discussions documenting all seven core decision items, compared with periods before each board's switch-on?
items.population: Case discussions at the network's 11 tumour boards, January to December 2027
items.intervention: Template package from each board's switch-on date
items.comparator: The same boards' discussions before switch-on
items.outcome: All seven core decision items documented

items.text: Does the package shorten the time from discussion to first treatment and change patients' understanding of their plan, without lengthening meetings?
items.population: Same discussions and the patients discussed
items.outcome: Days to first treatment; five-item understanding score; meeting duration

finer: Feasible within the rollout and three data-manager days a month; interesting to the network board and patients; novel as a controlled evaluation; ethical under the approved evaluation; relevant because the design must be approved in November 2026.
summary: One primary and one secondary PICO question.
